parent_stems.111.4(b)(2): Number and operations: represent and compare whole numbers using place value.
parent_stems.111.4(b)(3): Number and operations: recognize and represent fractional units and name parts of a whole.

parent_level_interpretation: The two quoted parent scopes are author paraphrases; the official parent stems must be checked independently.
publisher_language_rule: Official §111.4(a)(5): including denotes required content, such as introduces illustrative examples.

rows.scope: Use concrete and pictorial models to compose and decompose whole numbers up to 1,200 in more than one way, in thousands, hundreds, tens and ones.
Represent whole numbers up to 1,200 in standard form, word form and expanded form.
Generate a number greater than or less than a given whole number up to 1,200.
Compare and order whole numbers up to 1,200 using place value, comparative language, numerals and >, < or = symbols.
Locate a given whole number on an open number line.
Name the whole number corresponding to a specified point on a number line.
Partition objects into equal parts and name the parts in words, including halves, fourths and eighths.
Explain the inverse relationship between the number of equal fractional parts per whole and the size of each part.
material_qualifiers: more equal parts means smaller parts
fewer equal parts means larger parts

rows.scope: Use concrete models to count fractional parts beyond one whole using words and recognize how many parts equal a whole.
Identify examples and non-examples of halves, fourths and eighths.
